g.text: Logarithmic y-axis. Lower is better. Startup-inclusive child lifetime. Native = 1. No line implies a trend across unrelated programs.
1,350 adopted measurements; 4/7 SCTBench families; 57 source-matched assertion outcomes retained. Error bars are SD, not confidence intervals.
